description: Hand-built golden set for the Fee-Trap Finder. Each card's entry list is the complete set of fees that card actually charges. Fees marked 'None' or absent from the agreement are deliberately excluded (inclusion rule). This set is the human-certified answer key used to calibrate the LLM-as-judge grader; it is not machine-generated.

fields.amount: value + state; free text capturing the full pricing rule, not necessarily a single number
fields.trigger: value + state; plain-language condition that causes the fee, including escape hatches
fields.plain_language_warning: value + state; consumer-facing caution, led by cost, carrying the non-obvious trap
fields.source_quote: quotes (list) + state; verbatim clauses, line breaks stripped; one when grounded, empty when unstated, multiple when ambiguous
fields.severity: high | med | low; a judgment against the severity rule, no grounding state

field_states.note: Every field, including fee_name, carries its own state, assessed independently.
field_states.grounded: The field's value is supported by a verbatim quote or clause in the document.
field_states.unstated: No quote or clause in the document supports a value; the value cannot be found (e.g. an amount deferred to a separate disclosure). The fee still gets a record; this field's value says it is not stated. Distinct from a 'None'/absent fee, which is excluded entirely (see inclusion_rule).
field_states.ambiguous: The value cannot be determined because the document has competing clauses. Record the field and carry the competing clauses in source_quote rather than choosing one.

severity_rule.high: Path 1 OR Path 2 (either sufficient). Path 1: easily triggered by normal card use or non-use, AND a meaningful dollar amount, AND not obvious from the marketing. Path 2: a large fixed charge relative to the credit line, OR an APR at or near the top of the market.
severity_rule.meaningful_amount: A dollar amount a typical cardholder would find significant, not trivial. Anchors: $2 minimum interest is NOT meaningful; a $30-$41 late fee or a $95 program fee IS. Reference point is the cardholder's pocket, not a market comparison (market comparison is path 2's APR test). Absolute size lives in path 1's 'meaningful'; relative-to-credit-line size lives in path 2.
severity_rule.low: BOTH (a) the amount is minor judged on realistic total impact, not the per-charge amount (a small charge that recurs every cycle is NOT minor, since its yearly total is noticeable), AND (b) the fee is rarely triggered or trivially avoided. A tiny but recurring fee is med, not low. APRs are NEVER low: an APR is high (top of market) or med otherwise.
severity_rule.med: Residual by elimination: does not meet any high path AND does not meet the low floor. A real, noticeable fee that is neither severe nor trivial. NOT an 'unsure/cannot determine' bucket.
severity_rule.axes: Severity (harm if the fee applies, drives ranking) and confidence (field state) are separate axes. A fee can be high severity AND ambiguous. Severity carries no grounding state.

source_quote_model.purpose: Fee-level evidence: the verbatim clause(s) the consumer and the eval check the fee against.
source_quote_model.not_per_field: No field is mechanically tied one-to-one to source_quote; it need not contain a separate quote for every field. Each field's own state carries that field's grounding. In practice source_quote should hold the clauses behind the load-bearing facts (amount, trigger).
source_quote_model.selection: When several clauses support a field, use the most specific operative clause, not the summary-box version. When a field is ambiguous, carry the competing clauses.
source_quote_model.warning_constraint: The plain_language_warning must not state anything the DOCUMENT does not support (not merely 'anything in source_quote').
source_quote_model.eval_consequence: Groundedness = (a) every source_quote clause is verbatim in the document, AND (b) each grounded field is verified against the document, not against source_quote.
source_quote_model.hygiene: Never fabricate a quote. Strip PDF line breaks so quotes match verbatim. source_quote is list-valued.

trigger.value: Interest is charged on a purchase from the date of purchase until paid in full. Non-promotional purchases avoid interest in a billing cycle if you had no balance at the start of the cycle, or you paid the prior balance in full by the due date. Promotional purchases are always charged interest from the purchase date. If you did not pay the prior cycle's balance in full, interest is charged on the carried balance and on interest already accrued.

plain_language_warning.value: Pay your statement in full by the due date each month and you owe no interest on regular purchases. Carry any balance and it is charged 34.99 percent until fully paid. Note that a carried balance often includes unpaid interest, so you are charged interest on that interest too. Promotional purchases are the exception: they get no grace period and start accruing interest from the day you buy.

quotes: We charge interest on your purchases from the date you make the purchase until you pay the purchase in full.

We will not charge you interest during a billing cycle on any new non-promotional purchases if: 1. You had no balance at the start of the billing cycle; OR 2. You had a balance at the start of the billing cycle and you paid that balance in full by the due date in that billing cycle.
We always charge interest on promotional purchases and their related fees from the date you make the purchase.

If you did not pay your balance in full in the prior billing cycle, interest will be calculated on your balance from the first day of the current billing cycle until we receive your payment in full, even if you pay your balance in full and on time and make no new charges in the current billing cycle.

trigger.value: Ambiguous in the document. Page 1 states one late payment; page 2 states two or more missed minimums in any 12 consecutive billing cycles. The operative page-2 version is the accurate one.

plain_language_warning.value: Miss your minimum payment twice in a year and your rate can jump from 34.99% to 39.99%, and it can stay there indefinitely on your balance.

quotes: This APR may be applied to your account if you make a late payment.
A Penalty APR may be applied if we do not receive the total minimum payment due on your account by the payment due date two or more times during any 12 consecutive billing cycles.

trigger.value: If the interest calculated for a billing cycle is less than $2.00, you are charged $2.00 instead.

plain_language_warning.value: If you owe any interest in a month but the amount works out to less than $2.00, you are charged $2.00 instead. This only matters on very small balances, and it is minor.

quotes: If you are charged interest, the charge will be no less than $2.00.

amount.value: $30, or $41 if you were late in any of the prior six billing cycles. Never more than the minimum payment that was due.

trigger.value: You do not pay at least the total minimum payment by the due date.

plain_language_warning.value: If you miss your minimum payment by the due date, you are charged $30, and $41 if you have slipped even once in the last six months. Worse, two misses in a year can push your rate up to the 39.99% penalty APR.

quotes: We will charge this fee if we do not receive the total minimum payment due on your account by the due date in accordance with the requirements set forth on each billing statement.

amount.value: 2% of the total promotional transaction amount, including taxes, delivery and other applicable charges

trigger.value: Choosing a promotion of 18 months or longer that has no interest and requires equal monthly payments.

plain_language_warning.value: A long 'no interest' promotion still costs 2% of the full purchase, including tax and delivery. The fee is folded into your promotional balance and your equal monthly payments, so it is easy to miss. On a $2,000 promotional purchase that is a $40 fee.

quotes: 2% of total promotional transaction amount for some promotions with a duration of 18 months or more.

We will charge this fee, which may be referred to as a promo fee, for promotions 18 months or longer with no interest and required equal monthly payments. The promotional fee will be calculated based on the total promotional transaction amount, including taxes, delivery and other applicable charges. The promotional fee will be included in your promotional purchase balance used to calculate your required equal monthly payments.

amount.value: $30, or $41 if you had a returned payment fee in any one or more of the prior six billing cycles; not more than the amount permitted by applicable law

trigger.value: Any payment that is not honored, is returned unpaid, or cannot be processed for any reason, including a check, other instrument, or electronic payment authorization.

plain_language_warning.value: A bounced or unprocessable payment costs $30, rising to $41 if it happens again within six billing cycles. You can be charged even if the bank later resubmits the payment and it clears. The fee is added to your balance as a new purchase, so it also accrues interest at 34.99%.

quotes: We will charge this fee for any returned payment, such as if any check, other instrument, or electronic payment authorization you provide us in payment on your account is not honored, returned unpaid or cannot be processed for any reason.
$30, if you have not had a returned payment fee in each of the prior six billing cycles.
$41, if you have had a returned payment fee in any one or more of the prior six billing cycles.
A returned payment fee may be charged even if your payment is honored on a subsequent representment.

amount.value: $1.99 per month

trigger.value: Any billing cycle in which your balance is over $2.50 and you are sent a paper statement, even if you also receive it electronically. Avoided only by electing electronic-only statements on the servicing site.

plain_language_warning.value: Paper statements cost $1.99 a month, about $24 a year, unless you opt out. Also receiving e-statements does not waive the fee; you must choose electronic-only statements. The fee is added to your balance as a new purchase and accrues interest.

quotes: We will charge a $1.99 monthly Paper Statement Fee to your account. We will charge this fee in any billing cycle in which your balance is greater than $2.50 and you are sent a monthly billing statement in paper form, even if you also are provided it in electronic form. You can avoid the fee each billing cycle you are provided your monthly billing statement only in electronic form.

You are in default if you make a late payment, do not follow any other term of this Agreement or become bankrupt or insolvent.

quotes: We impose an Annual Fee on your Credit Account of $75.00 for the first year, and $45.00 for each subsequent year.

This fee will be billed until your Credit Account is closed and the balance is $20.00 or less.

quotes: Each time your Credit Account is eligible for and approved for an unsecured credit limit increase, a Credit Limit Increase Fee in the amount of 25% of the amount of the credit limit increase will be assessed to your Credit Account.

The first time you do not pay at least the Minimum Payment plus Past Due Amount by the cutoff time on your Payment Due Date, we will charge a Late Payment Fee of $28.00. If you do not pay at least this amount on time again in the next six billing cycles, we will charge a Late Payment Fee of $39.00 each time.

amount.value: Up to $28.00 the first time, up to $39.00 if another payment is returned within the next six billing cycles

trigger.value: A payment you make is returned unpaid. Can be charged even if the bank re-presents the item and it then clears.

plain_language_warning.value: A bounced payment costs up to $28, rising to up to $39 on a repeat within six cycles, even if the payment later clears on re-presentment.

quotes: If a payment you make is returned unpaid, we will charge you a Return Item Charge of up to $28.00. If another payment is returned in the next six billing cycles, we will charge a Return Item Charge of up to $39.00.

amount.value: 3% of the transaction amount in U.S. dollars

trigger.value: Any transaction in a foreign currency.

plain_language_warning.value: Foreign-currency transactions carry a 3% fee.

quotes: Foreign Currency Transaction Fee: 3% of the Transaction Amount in U.S. dollars.

amount.value: $29.00 per year for each additional card

plain_language_warning.value: Adding a card costs $29 a year, each.

quotes: We impose a $35.00 fee for the express delivery of your Card. This service is only available for lost, stolen, or replacement Cards.

amount.value: Not stated as a dollar amount; all court and collection costs, including reasonable attorneys' fees, Warning Bulletin costs, and card confiscation costs

trigger.value: Incurred as a result of your default. Covers court costs, collection costs, and reasonable outside attorneys' fees, with no cap stated.

amount.value: No less than $1.00 in any billing cycle in which interest is charged

trigger.value: Any billing cycle in which an interest charge based on a periodic rate is imposed.

plain_language_warning.value: If any interest is charged, it is rounded up to at least $1.00.

quotes: Minimum Interest Charge: If you are charged interest, the charge will be no less than $1.00.
The minimum INTEREST CHARGE is $1.00 for each Billing Cycle during which an INTEREST CHARGE based on a periodic rate is imposed.

amount.value: $3.00 per copy

plain_language_warning.value: A copy of a sales draft, statement, or other document costs $3 each.

quotes: If you request a duplicate of any sales draft, Statement, or other document, we will charge you $3.00 for each copy we provide.

amount.value: $5.00 per transaction

trigger.value: Each wire transfer.

plain_language_warning.value: Each wire transfer costs $5.

quotes: Wire Transfer Fee: $5.00 per Transaction.

amount.value: Not stated in this document; variable, set as the U.S. Prime Rate plus a Margin in the separate Credit Card Account Opening Disclosure.

plain_language_warning.value: Pay your purchase balance in full by the due date and you owe no interest on purchases. Carry any purchase balance and interest runs from the day each purchase posts. The rate is not in this agreement and moves with the Prime Rate.

quotes: The APR for purchases, balance transfers, and cash advances, applicable to your Account is determined by adding a Margin, as set forth in the Credit Card Account Opening Disclosure, to the Index in effect as of the first day of each billing cycle.
